title: What If You Spent One Night on the Moon?

scenes.text: What if you spent one night on the Moon? It lasts two weeks.
Sunset on the Moon starts about 14 Earth days of darkness.
There is no air to hold the heat, so the ground cools to about minus 200 degrees Celsius.
Daytime is the opposite: over 120 degrees Celsius, hotter than boiling water.
Batteries slow in that cold, so landers like Japan's SLIM survive by shutting down and hibernating.
NASA's ranking of technology gaps puts surviving the lunar night at number one. Pack a very good heater.
